summary: Scans a per-session gate array at this[68] (byte offset 0x110, 8-byte entries) over an index range computed from a2, and selects the highest-priority gate type with priority 3 > 8 > 2 > 0. Returns 3 immediately when an entry value of 3 is found; otherwise returns the best accumulated match (8, then 2), or 0 when the range is empty or nothing matches. Called by AISessionModeTransition and PitSelectionStateMachine.

operations.description: v3 = ShortComputation_7bf0(a2); compute the starting index of the gate scan range.
v4 = ArrayAccessAt0xcIndex4(a2); compute the inclusive ending index of the gate scan range.
result = 0; default selection is 'no gate selected'.
If v3 > v4 the range is empty; skip the scan and return result (0).
Iterate over gate entries starting at (this[68] + 8*v3) with an 8-byte stride, advancing the pointer i by 2 dwords each iteration.
Read the first dword v7 of each entry; if v7 == 3, break out of the loop as the highest-priority gate was found.
When result != 8, set result = 8 if v7 == 8, else set result = 2 when result != 2 and v7 == 2; 8 outranks 2 and an already-set value is kept.
If ++v3 > v4 after an entry, the range is exhausted; return the accumulated result.
Return 3 when an entry value of 3 broke the loop, or the accumulated result (8, 2 or 0) at range end.

unresolved: Global dword_8AD264 is listed as read evidence but does not appear in the raw source; its role here is unclear.
Semantics of gate values 2/8/3 (penalty gate priority selector) are DERIVED from caller context, not proven.
Callers AISessionModeTransition and PitSelectionStateMachine are the only known call sites.
